expected.charges: Framed on a charge of shooting a policeman.
expected.convicted: Convicted in the Tampa prosecution; completed his prison term before deportation, reported in February 1933.
expected.sentence: Served in the Indiantown State Road Camp and subsequently at Raiford. Completed the term and was deported by February 1933.

updates.sentence:
Served in the Indiantown State Road Camp and subsequently at Raiford. Completed the term and was deported by February 1933.

The November30,1932 Daily Worker interview continuation, page3, explicitly reports that Cabrera, Cruz and twelve others had been in Florida jails since their arrest at the November7,1931 Tampa meeting. This establishes continuous custody beginning on the already recorded arrest day. November11,1932 marks later solitary confinement at Raiford, not initial incarceration. Source: https://www.marxists.org/history/usa/pubs/dailyworker/1932/v09-n286-NY-nov-30-1932-DW-LOC.pdf#page=3
